method.name: RHI-MatSci
loop: propose prompt, contract, and hop mutation

initial_harness.name: H0_rhi_matsci

roles.instruction: Audit whether the proposed scientific action is grounded in visible evidence and not merely confident language.
Estimate action reliability and choose proceed only when selective risk is controlled.
If the action is not reliable enough, route it to retrieve, simulate, ask, experiment, or abstain based on reducible uncertainty.

gates: Every decision has an action-level reliability probability.
Proceed thresholds are calibrated on validation data, not hand tuned on test data.
Low reliability maps to an explicit fallback route, not generic refusal.

harness.name: H1_trajectory_feedback

roles.instruction: Audit whether the proposed scientific action is grounded in visible evidence and not merely confident language.
Estimate action reliability and choose proceed only when selective risk is controlled.
If the action is not reliable enough, route it to retrieve, simulate, ask, experiment, or abstain based on reducible uncertainty.
Check whether confidence tracks observed action reliability on the current discovery regime.
Select verification, simulation, expert review, or abstention based on OOD and action cost.

gates: Every decision has an action-level reliability probability.
Proceed thresholds are calibrated on validation data, not hand tuned on test data.
Low reliability maps to an explicit fallback route, not generic refusal.
Verbal confidence cannot override disagreement or missing evidence.
High OOD, high cost, or low reversibility requires an explicit verification hop.
Do not abstain when visible evidence is stable and the action is cheap and reversible.
Do not commit a costly or irreversible action while trajectory uncertainty remains unresolved.
After retrieval or simulation, require independent agreement before final execution.
Allow cheap reversible actions when evidence is stable even if confidence is not maximal.

retrieve and re-audit conflicting or OOD evidence
recalibrate cheap reversible actions before abstention
